title: Successor upper fibre-degree locus is quasi-compact on affine opens
statement: Let f : X ⟶ S be flat, locally of finite presentation, separated and quasi-finite. If the degree-≤r locus is closed, the universal degree-r criterion holds, and an affine open W lies in the degree-≥r locus, then the degree-≥r+1 locus intersected with W is compact.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ, proof, second paragraph
